stages.prompt: Set up a guest register with Guest { name, bookings } and Booking { guest, arrives_at, leaves_at }. Name is text and the two dates are timestamps. A guest has many bookings and each booking belongs to one guest; make those links navigable both ways. Add an index on arrives_at so we can efficiently show arrivals in date order.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type Guest { name: String bookings: [Booking] } type Booking { guest: Guest arrives_at: DateTime @index leaves_at: DateTime }
